headlines.title: A $28 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAxiom Investors opened an AMD stake, added 48% to GE Vernova and built up Lumentum in the June quarter. All three have fallen at least 23%, while AMD and GE Vernova’s average analyst targets still sit far above their prices.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Stock In Focus After Germany Wind Turbine Order
headlines.summary: GE Vernova reported that Stadtwerke Heidenheim AG ordered three 5.5 MW onshore wind turbines for the Schlotberg Jüchsen project in Germany, with locally manufactured hardware, commissioning targeted for December 2027, and a 20 year service agreement. The 16.5 MW order extends a long running partnership that now reaches 74 MW of installed GE Vernova onshore wind capacity for Stadtwerke Heidenheim in Germany, reinforcing recurring service revenue tied to a growing European fleet.

headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk posted on Nov. 6 that “SoftBank is defaulting on their turbine orders,” as SoftBank’s stock fell 45% in a month on its AI bets.

headlines.title: GE Vernova to Support India’s Energy Transition With 6-GW HVDC Transmission Project
headlines.summary: GE Vernova announced on Nov. 6 that it has been officially chosen by PowerGrid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL) to deliver a critical 6-GW High-Voltage Direct-Current (HVDC) transmission corridor. The project was booked in the fourth quarter of 2026.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
